Our Story

Where Pampanga's
Heart Meets Culinary
Excellence

Located in the City of San Fernando — Pampanga, the food capital of the Philippines — GECA opened its doors in October 2020. Founded by CEO Ms. Rovielyn A. Cabigquez on her deep passion for cooking, the academy was born with a single vision: accessible, world-class culinary education for every Filipino.

We offer globally-recognized programs with dedicated instructors, advanced equipment, and a curriculum designed to prepare graduates for careers in exciting food cities across the country and internationally.

"Education is not the filling of a pot, but the lighting of a fire."

Mission, Vision & Values

M
Our Mission

Creating Greater Opportunities for Every Filipino

Our roadmap starts with our mission — to turn ordinary people into extraordinary professionals through high-impact programs that open doors of opportunity, at the most affordable tuition fees.

Create greater opportunities to succeed in careers in any part of the world
Allow access to world-class, internationally recognized programs at affordable tuition
Provide the industry with positive, professional, and fully equipped practitioners
V
Our Vision

Changing the Education Landscape in the Philippines

Our vision guides every aspect of our business — to be a recognized authority and respected institution in trade education, in the Philippines and beyond.

Recognized authority in trade and culinary education nationwide
Operate campuses across the Philippines through strategic franchise
Offer degrees in culinary arts, hospitality, tourism, and beyond
